> Member nations shall take appropriate steps to prevent the abuse of hate crime legislation for political purposes or to suppress legitimate dissent and shall maintain procedural safeguards, including judicial oversight and the right of appeal, to avert such misuse.
Wouldn't this require nations without judicial oversight or an appeals process to implement those things just for the sake of combating the abuse of hate crime legislation?
I'm not *opposed* to that, to be clear. I've passed worse trickery myself
